_meta.description: Golden-set labels for the receipt extraction eval. Each entry maps a synthetic receipt PNG to its ground-truth fields.

matching_rules.vendor: Case-insensitive substring — AI may abbreviate or vary punctuation
matching_rules.amount: Exact numeric equality after parseFloat, tolerance ±0.01
matching_rules.category: Exact match against the seven allowed categories (soft warning, not counted in threshold)

receipts.note: Grocery/food purchase. Vendor name rendered as 'Woolworths Food' on the image — partial match on 'Woolworths' is acceptable.
Computer peripherals purchase. Full vendor name on image — AI should match exactly.
Fuel receipt. Vendor rendered as 'Shell Garage' — partial match on 'Shell' is acceptable.
Telecoms/data bill. Amount is clean integer — easy for AI to extract.
Legal fees invoice. Vendor rendered as 'Smith & Associates' — partial match on 'Smith' is acceptable.
